subject: Draft: Joint success slate for Atlas Health — MAP + evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Green <samuel.green@atlashealth.com>, Anna Lee <anna.lee@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Joint success slate for Atlas Health — MAP + evaluation timeline

Samuel / Anna — great to meet yesterday. As promised, attaching an initial joint success slate (MAP) and a 1st-pass evaluation timeline to get everyone aligned on scope and milestones. High-level ask: please review and confirm the success criteria owners and any security/compliance gating items we should fold into the pilot.

Summary (TL;DR)
- Proposed pilot: 45-day evaluation with three milestone gates (Week 1 infra + auth, Week 3 model validation, Week 6 acceptance).
- Success criteria: 1) 95% FHIR extraction accuracy on sample set, 2) <=200ms p95 inference on 2k sample queries (hosted), 3) integration of SSO + audit logging.
- Next steps: you review the MAP doc, mark owners, and confirm kickoff availability next week.

Attachments: atlas_MAP_v0.1.gdoc, eval_timeline_v0.1.xlsx
Draft links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AtlasMAPDraft | https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AtlasEvalTimeline

I'm copying Marissa who will put together a 1-slide exec summary, and Aditya who will own the demo/provisioning checklist.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

---

From: Samuel Green <samuel.green@atlashealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Lee <anna.lee@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft: Joint success slate for Atlas Health — MAP + evaluation timeline

Neha — thanks for sharing and for the clear summary. A few immediate notes/questions from our side:

1) Timeline: 45 days is doable but I want to propose a slightly different cadence: Week 1 infra/auth, Week 4 model validation, Week 7 acceptance (so ~7 weeks). We have internal procurement gating that sometimes lengthens the pilot. Can we build in a 2-week buffer?
2) Security/compliance: we will need SOC 2 evidence, an outline of data retention and deletion flows, and a draft PIR (privacy impact assessment) for the sensitive data we plan to use.
3) Success criteria: can you add a measurement plan for the FHIR extraction metric (what dataset, sampling method)?

Anna — looping you in because you'll be owning sign-off on the clinical validation side.

Thanks — Samuel
Samuel Green | Head of Data Engineering, Atlas Health
samuel.green@atlashealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0110

Subject: Re: Draft: Joint success slate for Atlas Health — MAP + evaluation timeline

Samuel — appreciate the quick read-through and the procurement context. A few commitments from our side:

- Buffer: happy to extend to a 7-week (45->49) formal window and keep the three gate structure; we will mark optional buffer weeks in the timeline so you can compress/expand based on internal approvals.
- SOC 2 / security evidence: I'll have our security lead assemble the SOC 2 summary and retention/deletion flow. I'll share a stub this week.
- Measurement plan: added a short appendix in the MAP doc describing datasets and sampling approach (link below).

I updated the draft to reflect tentative gate dates and added placeholders for the measurement plan and security ask. Marissa — can you produce a 1-slide exec summary that calls out the value thesis and asks? Aditya — can you confirm provisioning checklist ownership?

Updated draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AtlasMAPDraft (see "v0.2 - security & measurement appendix")
Attachment: pilot_milestones.pdf (first-pass dates + owner columns)

Proposed next meeting: Tue 09/21 10:00–10:30 PT for kickoff sync — does that work for your team?

Thanks — Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Draft: Joint success slate for Atlas Health — MAP + evaluation timeline

Hi Samuel / Anna — quick note from the internal side. I pulled the MAP into a co-edit GDoc and added a short exec summary. Key sections I added/changed:

- Executive one-liner + business outcomes (revenue ops / clinical efficiency uplift)
- Clear ownership table (we flagged Atlas owners as TBD — please fill)
- Risk & mitigations (data sensitivity, model drift checks, roll-back plan)
- Acceptance checklist (tie to success criteria above)

Slides: I created an "exec one-pager" you can show to your stakeholders: exec_onepager_slides.gslides
Link to co-edit MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AtlasMAPDraft (comment on the ownership table under "Week 1 owners")

Action items for Atlas (please): add the names for the decision owners in the ownership table, and confirm whether SSO will be provisioned via SAML or OIDC so we can list the integration steps.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. We're aligned on the expanded 7-week window and the milestone gates. A couple of outstanding items from our security/compliance team:

- Please share SOC 2 summary + retention/deletion flows before kickoff.
- We will need an explicit audit-log export plan and a point of contact for data-subject requests.
- SSO: we'll provision SAML; I'll confirm the IdP metadata and share next steps with Aditya.

Confirming kickoff: Tue 09/21 10:00–10:30 PT works for me. I'll invite Anna and our clinical lead.

Samuel
